mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_analysis_demand WHERE demand_key=#{demandKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM stock_watch_analysis_demand WHERE status='SUBMITTED' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='CLAIMED', lease_token=#{leaseToken}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED') AND (status!='CLAIMED' OR lease_until <= #{now})
UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET provider_submit_count=1, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CLAIMED' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND provider_submit_count=0

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='SUPERSEDED', active_coalesce_key=NULL, error_message=#{reason}, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='CLAIMED' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND analysis_task_id IS NULL

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='SUPERSEDED', active_coalesce_key=NULL, error_message=#{reason}, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CLAIMED' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND analysis_task_id IS NULL
UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET superseded_by_demand_id=#{supersededByDemandId}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SUPERSEDED'

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='SUPERSEDED', active_coalesce_key=NULL, error_message=#{reason}, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE symbol=#{symbol} AND market=#{market} AND source_policy_version IS NOT NULL AND source_policy_version != #{currentPolicyVersion} AND status='PENDING' AND analysis_task_id IS NULL

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='SUBMITTED', analysis_task_id=#{analysisTaskId}, provider_submit_count=1, active_coalesce_key=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CLAIMED' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='SATISFIED', analysis_task_id=#{analysisTaskId}, analysis_id=#{analysisId}, provider_submit_count=CASE WHEN #{analysisTaskId} IS NULL THEN provider_submit_count ELSE 1 END, active_coalesce_key=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, error_message=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('CLAIMED','SUBMITTED')

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='DEAD_LETTER', error_message=#{error}, active_coalesce_key=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status NOT IN ('SATISFIED','DEAD_LETTER')

UPDATE stock_watch_analysis_demand SET status='PENDING', not_before=#{notBefore}, error_message=#{error}, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CLAIMED' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken}
